appearance.modeSub: System follows your OS light/dark preference
appearance.densitySub: Compact tightens tables and controls to fit more on screen
appearance.languageSub: Translates the web console UI. Server console/chat messages are set separately in config.yml
appleify.title: Appleify
appleify.desc: Transforms Teletype into an Apple HCI experience — iOS navigation bars, Liquid Glass materials, Apple color system, and auto dark / light mode. Activate secretly: tap the Teletype logo 5 times.
funMode.title: Fun Mode
funMode.desc: Transforms Teletype into a simulated macOS desktop. Drag windows, resize them, use Spotlight (⌘K) to navigate. Finder opens the server filesystem.
greyBeard.title: Grey Beard Mode
greyBeard.desc: Kills anomaly detection, incident tooltips, log correlation, bifurcation gradients, and badge pulsing. Raw signal, no interpretation. For operators who trust their eyes.
glance.tpsSigmaSub: Flag TPS dips farther than N standard deviations
glance.enableLogCorrelationSub: Match chart anomalies to console log lines
glance.correlationWindowSub: How far from chart point to search for logs
glance.bifurcationMarkerSub: Dim/bright gradient split between historical and focus zones
glance.logPanelSub: Side panel showing live logs; click chart to jump
glance.statusBadgePulseSub: Animated glow on DEGRADED / INCIDENT badge
glance.msptZoneHint: MSPT (tick time) — green below, yellow/orange/red above
console.bufferLinesSub: Max log lines kept in memory
stats.defaultRangeSub: Time window shown when opening the Stats page
stats.playerCountSub: Online player count over time with join/leave markers
stats.loadedChunksSub: Total loaded chunks across all worlds
stats.pingPercentilesSub: P50 / P95 player latency (Paper forks only)
stats.performanceOverlaySub: TPS / MSPT / JVM mem / CPU on unified σ axis
stats.worldOverlaySub: Players / entities / chunks / ping on unified σ axis
stats.anomalyMarkersSub: Vertical markers where any series exceeds threshold; click for logs
stats.anomalyThresholdSub: σ beyond which a point is flagged
stats.correlationTableSub: Pearson r between all metric pairs
palette.enabledSub: Open with ⌘K (or Ctrl+K). Type run <cmd> to send console commands.
contextWheel.releaseToSelectSub: Hold Alt + right mouse, push into a sector, release to run it
editor.validateSub: Inline errors for JSON, TypeScript, JavaScript
editor.renderWhitespaceSub: Show space and tab markers at word boundaries
